entries.title: Psalms 79:1
segments: ¶<A Psalm. Of Asaph.> O God, the nations have come into your heritage; they have made your holy Temple unclean; they have made Jerusalem a mass of broken walls.

entries.title: Psalms 79:2
segments: They have given the bodies of your servants as food to the birds of the air, and the flesh of your saints to the beasts of the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 79:3
segments: Their blood has been flowing like water round about Jerusalem; there was no one to put them in their last resting-place.

entries.title: Psalms 79:4
segments: We are looked down on by our neighbours, we are laughed at and made sport of by those who are round us.

entries.title: Psalms 79:5
segments: How long, O Lord? will you be angry for ever? will your wrath go on burning like fire?

entries.title: Psalms 79:6
segments: ¶Let your wrath be on the nations who have no knowledge of you, and on the kingdoms who have not made prayer to your name.

entries.title: Psalms 79:7
segments: For they have taken Jacob for their meat, and made waste his house.

entries.title: Psalms 79:8
segments: Do not keep in mind against us the sins of our fathers; let your mercy come to us quickly, for we have been made very low.

entries.title: Psalms 79:9
segments: Give us help, O God of our salvation, for the glory of your name; take us out of danger and give us forgiveness for our sins, because of your name.

entries.title: Psalms 79:10
segments: Why may the nations say, Where is their God? Let payment for the blood of your servants be made openly among the nations before our eyes.

entries.title: Psalms 79:11
segments: Let the cry of the prisoner come before you; with your strong arm make free the children of death;

entries.title: Psalms 79:12
segments: And give punishment seven times over into the breast of our neighbours for the bitter words which they have said against you, O Lord.

entries.title: Psalms 79:13
segments: So we your people, and the sheep of your flock, will give you glory for ever: we will go on praising you through all generations.
